title: Progression
description: XP, skill points, perk cadence, and the level and skill caps. Formulas are trees (docs/core/formula.md); the luck roll is an input, not a roll.

xp_to_reach.description: Total XP needed for the level named by the var `level`.

skill_points.description: Points in one level's pool; reads the variable `luck_roll`.

pool_roll_max.description: The highest hp_roll, mp_roll, or sp_roll on a level-up.

skill_start.description: A skill's starting value; reads the variable `attribute`.

creation.description: The point-buy and the creation-perk cap of a new character (docs/core/progression.md#character-creation). The tag-skill count, the level-1 pool, and the skill base ratings are tag_skills, skill_points, and skill_start.

attribute_start.description: Every attribute before a point is spent.

attribute_points.description: Points to distribute among the eight attributes.

attribute_max.description: The highest attribute the points may reach, before racial modifiers and creation perks.

creation_perks_max.description: Creation perks (features of type creation) a character may take, from 0.

skill_group_cost.description: The price of one group rank on a grouped sheet: the skill cost (normal or tag) times ceil(members / members_per_step) (docs/core/progression.md#the-grouped-sheet-variant).

monster_skill_growth.description: What a monster's unwritten fighting skills gain per level above 1, capped at skill_cap; a skill whose category is not listed stays at skill_start (docs/core/actor-sheet.md).
